Definition: of Hebrew origin (H31); Abihud, an Israelite:--Abiud.
BiblicalUsage: Abihud appears in two places and nowhere else. In Chronicles he is a son of Bela and a grandson of Benjamin — ‘And the sons of Bela were, Addar, and Gera, and Abihud’ — and in Matthew he stands in the genealogy of Jesus after the exile, between Zerubbabel and Eliakim.
TheologicalSignificance: One name in a genealogy, with no story attached — and still the line runs through him to Christ. I believe Abihud is there for people like me who feel unremarkable: God keeps His promise through quiet generations too, and a name in the line is enough.
